scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); for (const dir of ['packages/core/dist','packages/server/dist','packages/cli/dist']) fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @vault-agent/core && npm run build --workspace @vault-agent/server && npm run typecheck --workspaces && tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.portable.json

VAULT_ID.description: Create a new UUID v4 with node -p "crypto.randomUUID()". Keep it stable after first upload.

READ_TOKEN.description: Generate an independent 64-character lowercase hex token with openssl rand -hex 32.

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Generate a different 64-character lowercase hex token. Allows scoped upload and indexing.

SOURCE.description: Private source, staging and immutable vault snapshots; do not enable public bucket access.

DB.description: Metadata, lexical indexes, checkpoints and retained embedding cache.
